what: request liveness (rule R3 = PRESENT and SERVER and ANCHOR and EPOCH), judged by an oracle that never reads the plugin's log
epoch: per plugin activation; a request asked before this activation's log began is never phone-answerable; since the ask, no abort/stop/idle/retry/delete for the session or any ancestor and no server.instance.disposed
oracle: the request's own call: LIVE when it was running at reply time and its result (or the exact reject/dismiss text) reached the model; DEAD on 404, a dead text, or a deleted session. Snapshots of a DEAD request are judged only after the first independent end event (boundary)
